name: What is the typical cost range for a custom barbecue island in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a custom barbecue island in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom barbecue island in the Los Angeles area can vary significantly based on size, chosen materials, appliances, and unique features. Basic installations with standard materials and a few appliances might start around $15,000 to $25,000. More elaborate designs incorporating premium stone, multiple high-end appliances, integrated seating, or complex electrical/plumbing can range from $30,000 to $70,000 or more. A detailed quote requires a site visit and design consultation to assess specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles, custom barbecue islands typically range from $15,000 for basic setups to over $70,000 for elaborate designs, depending on size, materials, and appliances.
